    echo "$out"
    break
  fi
  # Check for new Loss: lines
  loss_line=$(echo "$out" | grep -E "Loss:|=== |Results saved|Running" || true)
  if [ -n "$loss_line" ]; then
    echo "$loss_line"
  fi
  sleep 60
done
